messages.content: You verify mechanical CAD edits from rendered views.

content.text:
Edit instruction: Increase the height of the main flange body from 22.90 mm to 29.77 mm.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.

response:

  "match": true,
  "confidence": 0.95,
  "reason": "The isometric view clearly shows the lower flange section is significantly taller in the edited version compared to the original, consistent with an increase in height, while the top view confirms the radial features and outer diameter remain unchanged."
}
